model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts illustrating the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in 2021, based on NACE Rev. 2 classification. Each chart contains four segments corresponding to these sectors, with the segments labeled by sector name, color, and absolute value in millions (for enterprises and employment) or billions (for turnover), alongside their percentage share of the total. In the “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES” chart, the blue segment for Other Services accounts for 61% (19.0 million), the red segment for Trade for 19% (5.9 million), the light blue segment for Construction for 12% (3.7 million), and the yellow segment for Industry for 8% (2.4 million). In the “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED” chart, the blue segment for Other Services represents 51% (80.2 million), the red segment for Trade 19% (29.5 million), the light blue segment for Construction 9% (13.4 million), and the yellow segment for Industry 21% (33.0 million). In the “TURNOVER” chart, the yellow segment for Industry constitutes 33% (10.6 billion), the red segment for Trade 31% (9.9 billion), the blue segment for Other Services 31% (9.8 billion), and the light blue segment for Construction 6% (1.9 billion). The charts are arranged horizontally, and a shared legend at the bottom identifies each sector by color: yellow for Industry, light blue for Construction, red for Trade, and blue for Other Services. Each chart includes numerical values and percentage labels within its respective segments, and all segments are visually distinct by color without any being emphasized or resized beyond their proportional representation.
